description: Get the date a US bank (ACH) transfer would actually settle. Accounts for Iron's 3:00 PM ET same-day cutoff, weekends, AND US federal bank holidays — a transfer sent the afternoon before Thanksgiving does not arrive the next day. Use this to answer 'when will my money arrive?' instead of saying 'next business day'. USD/ACH only; Iron publishes no equivalent cutoff for EUR/SEPA.

submittedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the transfer was submitted. Omit to estimate for a transfer sent right now.

name: get_settlement_estimate
